units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:57">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 559:5">Yalk. Mic. 559</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00412"><he>שׁוֹכְחָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31b:5">Sabb. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא תאמר ש׳ היא מהן</he> lest you say, they forget it (that their way leads to death); a. fr.

senses.gloss: that which is forgotten, esp. (with ref. to Deut. XXIV, 19) the forgotten sheaf, the poor man’s sheaf.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:1">Peah VI, 1</cite> <he>אינו ש׳</he> does not come under the law concerning a forgotten sheaf, does not belong to the poor.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>ושלאחריו ש׳</he> and a sheaf left behind the cutter belongs to the poor; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 11a:19">B. Mets. 11ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 11a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>לרבות שִׁכְחַת העיר</he> to include a sheaf forgotten in town (at unloading). Pesik. Vattom., p. 132ᵃ (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 49:14">Is. XLIX, 14</cite>) <he>כעומר הש׳</he> like the forgotten sheaf; a. fr.
